features: TRIPLE THE SNACKS: Store & dispense not one, but up to three different snacks with the candy machine’s 3 compartments
360 DEGREE SELECTION: The base can spin 360 degrees for easy snack selection
EASY-TO-USE: Remove the lid for easy filling. Use the fingertip dispenser for easy snack distribution
IDEAL USE: Great for jelly beans, peanuts, gumballs, and other small snacks
description: Enjoy your favorite snacks at your convenience With the triple candy machine. Choose up to 3 different snacks to fill up the 3 available compartments. The base’s 360 spin capabilities allows easy access to each snack compartment. Whether its jelly beans, gum balls, Peanuts, or other tiny snacks, simply remove the top lid for easy filling. The fingertip dispenser provides easy distribution of your snacks.
